verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a visual workflow builder for multi-step agent conversations (elevenlabs-agents-docs-5) plus conversation-flow settings for turn-taking, interruptions, and timeouts (elevenlabs-agents-docs-33/42), supporting no-code design. However, evidence lacks detail on explicit branching/state/handoff UI mechanics or independent hands-on confirmation of the builder's depth. Missing for 10: detailed documentation or screenshots of branching logic, state management, and agent-to-agent handoff within the visual builder, plus independent/hands-on validation.
